straight.geometry: vertical riser, same column, reaches the nearest occupied cell above

right.geometry: diagonal riser up-and-right, reaches the nearest occupied cell above in the column to the RIGHT

connector_texture_geometry.note: spacing is the render tile pitch (one tier row), NOT the connector reach

_meta.reach_rule: skillConnectionOn draws to the NEAREST OCCUPIED cell above in the same column (straight) or column-right (right); spans gaps
